text: Warwick learns by making and looking at things; he is visual and process-minded, has ADHD, and retains little from reading alone. Something must exist on screen or be built for learning to stick.
Concerto Studio, Launch and RAID were each built as a single-tab web app that was extended tab by tab as need arose. The pattern is proven for Warwick.

Claude Code is logged in on this machine (Yoga). Print mode (`claude -p`) runs on the subscription, so a local tool needs no Anthropic API key. Concerto Studio uses the same approach on the work machine.
